Pick a variable to see how it changed between 1997 and 2024, or how responses are distributed in a given wave, overall or by sex, age and education. Hover over the chart to see each value with its confidence interval; **Download CSV** gets the data behind what you are looking at.

```{=html}
<iframe src="../../explorar/app/index.html?lang=en" title="Explore ENEM" class="enem-app" loading="lazy"></iframe>
<style>

</style>
```

::: {.callout-note}
## About the data
The app runs entirely in your browser; the first load can take a few seconds. It shows weighted percentages and means by wave and group, computed with [rENEM](https://ddjpgarcia.github.io/rENEM/) on the harmonized panel. It contains no microdata: to work with the full surveys, [download the data](../data/index.qmd) or use the [variable finder](../variables/index.qmd).
:::
